Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan

PURCHASER'S DATA SHEET FOR 
PULVERIZERS 



1. Scope — Covers the techicai data to be supplied by a purchaser while placing an enquiry or order 
to a supplier for the purchase of a pulverizer. 

2. Purchaser's Data Sheet 



PURCHASER'S DATA SHEET FOR PULVERIZERS 



Material Characteristics 

1) Name of the material to be pulverized 

2) Nature of material: 

a) Inflammable 

b) Decomposable 

c) Toxic 

d) Explosive 

e) Clayey 

f) Sticky 

g) Abrasive. 

h) Corrosive 

i) Dry 

k) Granular 

m) Round 

n) Damp 

p) Wet 

q) Flaky 

r) Any other 

3) Bulk density g/cm 3 

4) Melting point.. °C 

5) Compressive strength N/m 2 

6) Grindability index or Bond's work index 

7) Hardness (Moh's scale) 

8) Any temperature limitations for the material 

9) Reasons for the temperature limitations 

10) Moisture content .percenf 

11) Oil or fat content percent 

12) Abrasive content. percent 

13) Silica content percent 

14) Magnesia content percent 

15) Aluminium oxide content percent 

16) Clay content i percent 

17) Any other substance present percent 

18) Feed temperature °C 

19) Sieve analysis of feed: 

Sieve designation and width of aperture Percent mass between sieves

44) Any special requirement 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

The information given by a purchaser according to this data sheet will enable a manufacturer or 
supplier to assess the exact requirements of the purchaser and recommend to him the most suitable type 
of equipment. 

International system (SI) of units has been used in the standard. The relationship of these units 
to other units are given below for guidance: 

1 pascal (Pa) = 1 newton/square metre (N/m 2 )
